SELECT tmp1.equMark, tmp1.indentifyMark, tmp1.registBankCode, tmp2.fundAccPlace, tmp2.agencyCode, tmp2.orgIndentifyMark FROM( SELECT 'SUB' equMark, INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode FROM CHB_EQU_SUB WHERE FUND_ACC_PLACE is NULL OR THE_BANK_CODE is NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'CHECK' equMark, INDENTIFY_MARK indentifyMark, REGIST_BANK_CODE registBankCode FROM CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK WHERE FUND_ACC_PLACE is NULL OR THE_BANK_CODE is NULL ) tmp1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT(ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK) as orgIndentifyMark, INDENTIFY_MARK as indentifyMark, FUND_ACC_PLACE as fundAccPlace, AGENCY_CODE as agencyCode FROM CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE TO_CHAR(EQUITY_CONF_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} group BY ORG_INDENTIFY_MARK, AGENCY_CODE, INDENTIFY_MARK, FUND_ACC_PLACE) tmp2 ON tmp1.indentifyMark = tmp2.orgIndentifyMark GROUP BY tmp1.equMark, tmp1.indentifyMark, tmp1.registBankCode, tmp2.fundAccPlace, tmp2.agencyCode, tmp2.orgIndentifyMark
SELECT COUNT(*) from CHB_EQUDET_SUB WHERE TO_CHAR(EQUITY_CONF_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.update: UPDATE CHB_EQU_SUB SET FUND_ACC_PLACE = #{fundAccPlace,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, THE_BANK_CODE = NVL(#{agencyCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{registBankCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) WHERE INDENTIFY_MARK = #{orgIndentifyMark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

update CHB_EQU_HOLD_CHECK SET FUND_ACC_PLACE = #{fundAccPlace,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, THE_BANK_CODE = NVL(#{agencyCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{registBankCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) WHERE INDENTIFY_MARK = #{orgIndentifyMark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
